Students must complete a minimum of 120 units with a Pacific cumulative and program grade point average of 2.0 in order to earn the Bachelor of Music degree in Performance (Voice).

","groupId":"dfb3ea52-5587-4afc-810e-01956d63d3f4","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"General Education Requirements","groupId":"c38e8ebf-c163-443f-8b44-01956d645dc7","position":2,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

For more details, see General Education

Minimum 28 units and 9 courses that include the following requirements.

","groupId":"8c62ef9a-cf7b-4ae6-9129-01956d645dc7","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"CORE Requirements","groupId":"e0e6a822-54a9-4c58-a657-01956d650dbf","position":4,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

1) CORE Seminars cannot be taken for Pass/No Credit. 

2) Transfer students with 28 or more transfer credits taken after high school are exempt from both CORE seminars.

Note: No more than 2 courses from a single discipline can be used to meet the Breadth Requirement.

All students must complete Diversity and Inclusion coursework (at least 3 units)

Note:  Diversity and Inclusion courses can also be used to meet the breadth category requirements, or major or minor requirements.

Students must demonstrate competence in:

Writing

Quantitative Analysis (Math)

Note: Failure to satisfy the fundamental skills requirements by the end of four semesters of full-time study at the University is grounds for academic disqualification.

","groupId":"2003e320-5543-4c05-9b86-01956d664188","position":11,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralTitle","content":"Major Requirements","groupId":"6f43936a-627f-4f93-a5ba-01956d69844a","position":12,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Notes:

Students are required to take:

1) 8 semesters of at least 16 units and up to 32 units of MAPM.

2) 8 units and 8 semesters of MPER and MHIS, based on placement auditions.

5) A maximum of 20 Music electives.
